method: Independent image-only reading of the assigned source, anonymous boxes and one prepared set of crops. Every crop was inspected. No witnesses, first readings, approved pages, reports or comparison output were opened. The source was viewed once for layout. The marginal crop alone was rotated. B017 had one unsuccessful truncated display attempt followed by one successful display of the same existing crop. Broad overlapping boxes were read independently and their readings kept consistent.

box_notes.evidence: The marginal writing rises to the right in the source; a minus-40-degree rotation makes its six lines approximately horizontal. The first two lines read On aura / intérêt ici. The third has the descender of prendre and a separate final S. The abbreviated comp has a p descender but no secure independent stop; can. has a separate stop. The last line distinguishes large K and small k and ends in three marks.
box_notes.scope: Only the rotated marginal note is transcribed. Body fragments intersecting the right and lower edges have a different writing angle and are excluded. No note-to-body leader was seen.

box_notes.evidence: The first word has a low initial loop, a tall loop and a short low ending. These favor alors, but the tall loop could be d in dans. The following les has a tall l and low e/s.
box_notes.scope: Both complete words on the principal line are included.

box_notes.evidence: The ascending d and e, low open c and e, and final mathematical k with tall stem and branching right arm are visible. There is no final punctuation.
box_notes.scope: Principal complete phrase only.

box_notes.evidence: The complete words de, sous and groupes are legible. No independently separate hyphen lies between the final sous stroke and the opening g. The g loop and p descender are visible.
box_notes.scope: The source gap is retained as sous groupes; no normalized hyphen is supplied.

box_notes.evidence: The first main symbol has a triangular outline but also an upper horizontal bar and central upright that could belong to I or a rewrite. The low s-prime is visible. An upper-right crossed cluster is tentatively xi-like, but neither its full shape nor whether it is cancelled can be settled. The right main symbol combines E-like curves and K-like arms; its separate lower K is clear. The intervening de is clear.
box_notes.scope: The entire formula fragment is recorded with explicit symbol and state uncertainty. No underlying overwritten symbol has been made certain and no mathematical repair was made.

box_notes.evidence: A full opening parenthesis precedes pour, whose p descends; sa has a curved s and a low a loop.
box_notes.scope: The parenthesis continues in overlapping boxes.

box_notes.evidence: Structure is followed by two distinct vertically separated dots. La is clear. The following large glyph has two humps, and two distinct horizontal bars follow it. The wider B010 independently makes those bars clearer.
box_notes.scope: Literal M= is retained; it is not expanded to a French word. Lower clipped context is excluded.

box_notes.evidence: The upper word has e/x, a tall crossed t, low ension and a dotted i. The lower word has a tall l, t, dotted i, and v/e ending, supporting relative. A long curved leader begins before relative and runs beneath extension.
box_notes.scope: The leader places extension immediately before relative. It is not an opening parenthesis.

box_notes.evidence: Sur is clear; the E index is a compact k-like form. Three separate marks follow the formula, then a large closing parenthesis and a separate comma.
box_notes.scope: The three marks are retained as ellipsis; no relation sign or extra stop is supplied.

box_notes.evidence: This larger box confirms the two source lines, the literal M followed by an equals sign, the extension leader, and the closing ellipsis/parenthesis/comma. It does not settle the heavily retraced two group labels or the upper-right cluster on the first symbol.
box_notes.scope: All principal complete text on the two lines is included. Clipped material from the preceding line at the top is context only. Decisions agree with B004-B009.

box_notes.evidence: Et les and qui are legible. The N has two uprights and a slant, with a low s-prime. The phrase stands above the old baseline and follows the parenthesis before the live sont on the next line.
box_notes.scope: The full interlinear addition is included; clipped structure above is context only.

box_notes.evidence: The tiny struck opening has a c-like curve and a small e-like trace but remains doubtful. Sont and justement have visible low strokes and tall t forms, and justement has its initial descending j.
box_notes.scope: The cancelled word remains under doubt. Top pieces of B011 are contextual.

box_notes.evidence: The upper les sous-groupes is legible, with a separate short dash before g. The following de has a raised mark that might instead make dé. The lower struck word has initial low n/o/r/m/a-like traces, a tall l, a dot, a later t and a low ending, tentatively normalisateurs; its interior is obscured by cancellation.
box_notes.scope: The physical upper and lower lines are kept separate. The cancelled word is not asserted as fully recovered.

box_notes.evidence: The upper décomposition has its d, accented e, p descender, t and dotted i. The crossed lower word is tentatively inertie; cancellation obscures several interior joins. Live des remains at the right.
box_notes.scope: The upper word replaces the cancelled lower word. The cancelled reading stays doubtful.

box_notes.evidence: Des at the left is complete. The next word has a first tall d-like stem, low joined strokes, a second tall form, an i dot and terminal t/s-like strokes. Desdits is a tentative reading only. A separate comma is clear.
box_notes.scope: The repeated des is not removed on grammatical grounds. No formula is inferred from the crowded word.

box_notes.evidence: The lower l-extension sequence is live despite retraced final strokes. Above it de N with s-prime followed by sur is legible. A long curved leader passes below the upper phrase and bends down after the baseline word.
box_notes.scope: The addition attaches after l-extension. The long right curve is a leader rather than a comma or cancellation; clipped on peut above is context only.

box_notes.evidence: The first E has a lower k(s), without an independently visible prime. The relation is a c-shaped subset sign with no lower bar or right arrowhead. The next E has a clear capital K. The small lower label has an initial o and compressed u/v/e/r/t-like continuation, read ouvert; it is placed beneath the relation. Dans is complete at the right.
box_notes.scope: The whole formula, lower inserted label and complete right word are included. Other clipped fragments at the lower edge are excluded. The first display attempt was truncated before inspection; the existing crop was then successfully displayed once, without regeneration.

box_notes.evidence: An opening parenthesis precedes a low s/o/r sequence, a tall crossed t, e and a terminal s return, read sortes. De at the right has a looped d and low e.
box_notes.scope: The opening parenthesis and both complete words are retained; no close is supplied.

box_notes.evidence: The word begins with c/o and a long low n-like join, then a deep descending-and-returning stroke with a separate high mark. The compact remainder is u/g/u/e/s-like but its letters cannot all be separated. Conjugués is therefore tentative.
box_notes.scope: No unseen letters or expansion are asserted with certainty.

box_notes.evidence: The added upper phrase has readable la section, rat. with a distinct stop, de, U with a lower K, sur and S. A very long curved leader carries this phrase to the place of a heavily crossed baseline symbol. The old symbol is tentatively E but cannot be fully recovered. Est is live. Définie has an independent underline, visible d/f stems and dotted i; en follows.
box_notes.scope: The insertion replaces the doubtful cancelled symbol before est. The leader is not punctuation. Material from the preceding line at the very top is excluded.

box_notes.evidence: The beginning has c, a long low o/n join, s and a dotted short stroke. A further tall stem is followed by an independent dot and a high crossed final t. This supports the literal short form consid.t, but its crowded middle remains uncertain.
box_notes.scope: The short form is preserved without expansion. Clipped lower context is excluded.

box_notes.evidence: Section has its tall crossed t and dotted i. The upper partielle has a p descender, t, dot and two l stems. Its curved leader begins between section and the live est un.
box_notes.scope: Partielle is inserted directly after section. Previous-line fragments at the top are excluded.

box_notes.evidence: The main E bears a U index with a further lower K. A short horizontal link has no arrowhead and functions as a written hyphen. The following word has a tall initial t and low o/r/s/e/u/r sequence, read torseur. The final word has a d stem and terminal hook, favoring des over de.
box_notes.scope: The whole formula fragment and complete words are included. No stop is supplied.

box_notes.evidence: The left formula reads E with lower k(s). Its link has a curved left hook, horizontal shaft and a distinct two-arm right head. The right E has a retraced but clear K index. A separate round stop follows.
box_notes.scope: The complete formula and final period are retained. Retracing of K is not treated as a deletion.

box_notes.evidence: The first word has heavily retraced e/s but a clear tall final t. The second has c, a long low o/n join, s, a crossed tall t and a separate terminal stop, supporting const.
box_notes.scope: Both words are live; const. is not expanded.

box_notes.evidence: Et has a clear tall crossed t. A small faint separate mark follows it; whether it is intended as a stop is uncertain. The deleted phrase shows e, two l stems, e, then a second e and final t; the middle of the last word lies under the strike, so est remains doubtful.
box_notes.scope: The faint punctuation and the obscured deleted word are explicitly uncertain. The top formula fragment is contextual.

box_notes.evidence: The opening tall curve may be a parenthesis touching the following un, so its state is uncertain. The next compressed group has a tall crossed t, low retraced middle and a high final return, tentatively tors, with très also possible. The last group has a long q-like descender, low joined strokes, a dot over a short stroke, then a tall right-branching form and a stop; quasi f. and qui y. remain competing tentative readings.
box_notes.scope: This row deliberately preserves the uncertain whole wording instead of selecting it from grammar or mathematical context. No hyphen has been supplied in quasi f.

box_notes.evidence: The lower cancelled word has a visible e and tall t, but its interior is crossed. A separate dark mark after it may be a period or comma. The upper replacement has an initial small loop, two very tall f-like stems with a shared crossing, a low middle, t, a short dotted stroke and a v/e-like ending, tentatively effective. A curved leader attaches it before live sur.
box_notes.scope: The replacement and cancelled word remain uncertain; the intervening mark is not silently omitted. Clipped material above is contextual.

box_notes.evidence: The formula fragment has a long top bar and two descending stems, read pi. A large closing parenthesis follows. The next crossed word exposes e and a tall t, but the middle is obscured, so est is doubtful.
box_notes.scope: No comma is added after the closing parenthesis. The top fragments are context only.

box_notes.evidence: The wider view confirms the physical two-line parenthesis, the three cancellation groups, the upper replacement leader, pi and the close. It does not settle the compressed tors/très and quasi f./qui y. sequence. After the close and struck word, n-est autre que celle qui a is legible, including the double l of celle and dotted i of qui.
box_notes.scope: The principal lower passage is transcribed through its last complete word a. The preceding formula and clipped preceding-line words at the top, and incomplete following-line material at the bottom, are contextual and excluded. Decisions remain consistent with B026-B029 and B031.

box_notes.evidence: The opening n and apostrophe are separate, followed by compressed est. Autre has an independent tall crossed t; que has a long q descender and low u/e.
box_notes.scope: All three complete words are included; no punctuation is supplied.

box_notes.evidence: The first numeral is a looped 9 with a long descending tail. The second has a top bar, downward stem and middle crossbar, reading 7.
box_notes.scope: The handwritten lower-left folio is 97.

B020: the cancelled baseline symbol is not fully recoverable.
